alate: Head deep brown, the dorsum of the thorax and abdomen brown, wing membrane white and veins pale brown; head and pronotum densely covered with pubescence. Head flat and rounded; fontanelle oval and depressed, with a group of pale small spots in front of it; compound eyes subcircular, their long diameter about four to five times the distance between them and the lower margin of the head; the long diameter of the ocelli about twice the ocellus-compound eye distance; labrum semicircular; postclypeus trapezoidal, less than half as long as wide; antennae with 15 segments, the third shortest, the antennal spot cloud-like; the anterior margin of the pronotum nearly straight, the lateral margins steeply oblique backwards, the posterior margin projecting with a shallow median concavity.
distribution: Jinghong and Mengla, Yunnan; Wuming, Guangxi.
soldier: Head yellowish brown and densely covered with short pubescence, mandibles purplish brown, thorax and abdomen pale yellow. Head nearly trapezoidal, the lateral margins slightly oblique backwards, widest beside the base of the mandibles, the anterior and posterior margins nearly straight; labrum semicircular; mandibles hooked, each with a large blunt tooth behind the apical third; antennae with 14 segments, the third slightly longer than the second; postmentum club-shaped, the waist 0.25–0.28 mm wide; pronotum saddle-shaped, the middle of the posterior margin shallowly concave and depressed.
